- Health, genetic and biometric information

As one way to put this morning’s controlled detonation into perspective, I have been informed that the release of particulate matter from Kansas City’s fireworks show at FIFA World Cup FanFest was roughly 10x greater than this morning’s detonation.

After collecting 1,200 land, air, dust, and water samples before the detonation, 300 EPA personnel and contractors were pre-positioned for continued sampling during and after the detonation.
